platform: Cloud SaaS and browser-based higher-education SIS/ERP; hybrid installed base includes documented legacy on-premise deployment.

distinctive_features.feature: Specialized U.S. financial-aid workflows, including clock-hour, non-term, crossover, COD, R2T4, and automated packaging.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions with complex aid programs can manage specialized regulatory and disbursement processes within the student system.

distinctive_features.feature: Configurable Views with grids, charts, related-object queries, filters, pinning, and OData export.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Staff can create reusable analyses across modules rather than depending exclusively on fixed reports.

distinctive_features.feature: Scheduling AI Assistant analyzes historical registration and section-demand data.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Scheduling teams can identify likely section demand and faculty-hiring needs.

distinctive_features.feature: Opt-in AI Product Guide answers questions from curated product documentation without accessing student data.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Users can get product guidance while keeping student records outside the assistant's data access.

distinctive_features.feature: Cross-module hold codes can control registration, transcripts, aid disbursement, graduation, or housing placement.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can enforce operational restrictions consistently across student lifecycle processes.

distinctive_features.feature: Forms Builder and Workflow Composer provide configurable forms and process automation.
distinctive_features.why_it_matters: Institutions can adapt some workflows without relying solely on custom development.

weaknesses.issue: Users report occasional slowness, downtime, dated appearance, complexity, and limited mobile functionality.
Reviews cite slow or frustrating support and duplicated inquiries.
Schedule lookup and history filtering can be unintuitive or difficult.
Users report limited customization and unintuitive multi-step workflows that require training.
Pricing is unpublished, and historical reviews report expensive migration and managed services.
Ownership and portfolio divisions among Ellucian, Encoura, and Blackboard create roadmap and contract-governance uncertainty.
Core Student lacks native transport, library, medical, discipline, special-education, alumni fundraising, and LMS capabilities.

ai_features: Opt-in Azure OpenAI GPT-4o product-guide assistant grounded in curated documentation; it does not access student data.
Class Scheduling AI Assistant analyzes seat projections and recent registration history to identify section-demand needs.
pricing_model_summary: No public rate card or free trial; pricing is quote-based, with modules, hosting, implementation, migration, training, and services potentially priced separately.
biggest_strategic_gap: It is a specialized higher-education SIS/ERP, not a complete school platform; several student-success, teaching, and campus-service needs require separate products or integrations.
